7447123.sourceDescription: Add a contemporary twist to your Christmas tree with this pack of 3 glass baubles in blue. The speckled black finish across each one brings a modern, artistic feel that lifts your decorations beyond the traditional. Each bauble comes pre-threaded with soft velvet ribbon, so you can hang them straight from the box and start building your look. The bold colour pairing and graphic speckled pattern create visual interest on the tree, whether you're clustering them together or spreading them across the branches. Made from glass, they catch the light beautifully and add depth to your festive display. It's a simple way to introduce a sophisticated edge to your Christmas styling and make your tree feel curated and confident. . 3 decorations included.; Contains gold pre-threaded baubles.; Size H6, W6, D6cm.; Made from glass.; Suitable for indoor usage.

k30hesky.variantName: Christmas Tree World 4ft Arbor Vitae Fir Half Christmas Tree
k30hesky.sourceDescription: If you are looking for a stylish artificial Christmas half tree this year, look no further than the Italian designed Arbor Vitae Fir Half Tree collection. Half-trees are becoming increasingly popular in homes and businesses across the country, in addition to other trees or a space saving alternative. The range provides a number of different sized artificial trees, from 4ft to 6ft, so it's easy to find the perfect size for your room or venue. The Arbor Vitae Fir Tree is a traditional and high quality Christmas tree that is available at a great price. It's the perfect choice of tree for making your Christmas season that extra bit special. Please note: Accessories in the images are not included with purchase. Product Features • Size: 4ft • Number of Branch Tips: 180 traditional PVC branch tips • Tree Width: 83cm diameter • Half Tree: 50cm from standing against wall to tip of longest branch • Realistic look: High quality traditional PVC branch tips • Easy assembly: Attached pliable branches • Sturdy base: Folding metal stand with plastic tips to prevent scratching • Fire-resistant: Fire retardancy certified • Indoor use only: The trees construction will rust in rain • Height measured from the floor • Eligible for European shipping • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World, Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate, Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester, WN5 8DB, United Kingdom

1ak4x4gc.baseName: Walplus 333 Branch Tips Hinged Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 150 cm
1ak4x4gc.variantName: Walplus 333 Branch Tips Hinged Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 150 cm
1ak4x4gc.sourceDescription: This beautiful artificial hinged Christmas tree is very lifelike in its shape and appearance and is meant to create just the right atmosphere for this Christmas. Hinged construction: The Christmas tree has a hinged construction, so the branches will automatically fold down at the right angle. This will make it much easier to put up the tree in the perfect shape and will save you time as well.Lifelike PE tips: The Christmas decoration has realistic PE tips, made by injection moulding, giving the tree a more natural appearance.Sturdy stand: The iron stand provides your artificial Christmas tree with optimal sturdiness and stability.Beautiful decoration: The Christmas ornament has cones and red berries on it, creating a lovely natural look.Economical choice: You can reuse the holiday ornament every year, which is a cost-effective option compared to getting a real tree. Good to know:We recommend setting aside 30-45 minutes after assembly to properly shape the tree by peeling back the branches and pulling the tips apart to give the branches a more full-bodied look. Product Specifications Tree colour: Green PVC (polyvinylchloride), PE (polyethylene), iron Total height: 150 cm Bottom diameter: 100 cm Stand size: 35 x 15 cm (W x H) Hinged construction With 333 PVC tips and 123 PE tips Decorated with 36 cones and 36 red berries Suitable for sheltered areas such as roofs, balconies, canopies, etc. Assembly required: Yes Delivery contains: 1 x Artificial hinged Christmas tree 1 x Stand • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

wmeads0h.baseName: My Christmas Artificial Christmas Garland with Pine Cones and 30 LED Lights
wmeads0h.variantName: My Christmas Artificial Christmas Garland with Pine Cones and 30 LED Lights
wmeads0h.sourceDescription: This 270cm/9ft pre-lit Christmas garland adds a festive touch to mantels, staircases, doorways, windows, fireplaces and other Christmas displays. Featuring dense green PVC tips, it creates a full and realistic appearance, while 14 snow-dusted pinecones and 7 clusters of red berries add classic seasonal detail. The garland includes 30 warm LED lights that provide a soft, cosy glow and requires 3 AA batteries, which are not included. Its flexible design makes it easy to shape and position around your home or office. Specifications: 270 cm pre-lit Christmas garland, dense green PVC tips, 30 warm LED lights, 14 snow-dusted pinecones, 7 clusters of red berries, flexible and easy to shape, battery operated, requires 3 AA batteries (not included), and suitable for indoor festive decoration. Dimensions: Length: 270cm/9ft. Read the operating instructions before use. Vivo Technologies Limited, Unit 11, Rainsford Road, London, NW10 7RG
